original_test_intent: Verify ADDDC behavior when a rank already protected by one-bank VLS receives a second threshold event in the protected bank on another device: no additional VLS operation starts, the established region remains, and the per-rank CE counter clears.
original_method: Record platform/DIMM and clean baseline; enable source SMI/threshold2/ADDDC/POR settings; establish and capture one-bank VLS bank/device/rank; halt; set the exact dev1 mask pattern for a different device and inject exactly two CEs at socket0/ch0/dimm0/rank0/subchannel0/bankgroup0/bank0; confirm threshold through adddc_status_check; go once; verify copy_in_progress=0, unchanged VLS region and cleared rank counter; restore and verify health.
manual_activity: Intel-qualified owner/FAE establishes and attests the predecessor one-bank VLS region, validates the different-device target, drives exactly two CEs/go and controls recovery while the agent correlates ADDDC state.
required_inputs: GNR/BIOS/BMC/OS, DIMM topology and POR/non-POR disposition
CScripts version/hash/license and SMI/threshold2/ADDDC path mapping
Immutable one-bank VLS failed/buddy rank, bank and failed-device baseline
Proof dev0=1 pattern targets a different device in the same bank and expected threshold/counter fields
Serial/OOB recovery plus ADDDC/VLS restoration plan

Prove bank/device relation before injection and perform exactly two CEs
Stop on unexpected copy/failover, threshold mismatch, hang or region change

review_improvement: Makes the dependent predecessor state and different-device relationship auditable and converts a generic corrected-log check into the exact ADDDC negative-sparing and preservation decision.
independent_technical_reasoning: This case is not simply two CEs: it asks how ADDDC responds after one bank is already a VLS region. The second device in the same protected bank reaches the per-rank threshold, but the expected result is no additional copy because that bank is already represented. Thus copy_in_progress=0 is meaningful only alongside an immutable pre/post region comparison and counter clear after SMM. Any extra injection could trigger a different ADDDC path and invalidate the result.
